verdict.rationale: Checkout Pro is a single hosted integration with customizable payment methods (docs-4, docs-17). Its guest-pay option (docs-14) implies buyers can otherwise pay with a Mercado Pago account, which is itself a digital wallet. No named method from the story (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) is documented as available through the integration. missing for 10: Apple Pay support, Google Pay support, bank-redirect/local method list, BNPL/installment-lender options, independent corroboration of the payment method mix
